tasks.instruction: Implement ONE bounded acceptance slice. Read AGENTS.md and WORKING_RULES, docs/qa/enclosure-integration-review.md only, then app/aa-refinement-probe.js and app/enclosure-integration-probe.js as needed. Add independent AA/supersample acceptance for the experimental enclosureRefinement:true renderer. Reuse existing checkAARefinement by adding an optional reference-constructor-options argument (default behavior MUST stay unchanged), so both target and independent 2x reference use enclosureRefinement:true. Add app/enclosure-aa-probe.js exporting checkEnclosureAA(model,census,shots): create experimental renderer and census pose, call that shared AA checker with explicit candidate reference options, clean up GL context in finally, label result enclosure-aa. Do not wire into main app; lead will wire and run GPU acceptance. Keep existing strict numeric/refusal/color guards and memory fallback checks. Do not change geometry/shader/renderer or historical expectations to make checks pass. Only three allowed files. Run node --check on changed JS; no browser or full suite here (isolated checkout cannot use main queue), no commits/pushes/agents. Report unrun GPU checks explicitly and explain any integration caveat in under300 words. Aim <=20 targeted tool calls, no broad research/archives. Fresh bounded session; no automatic follow-up.
